newsitem.title: UK: Clean 30kt tanker rates for Mideast/Japan soft.
newsitem.headline: Clean 30kt tanker rates for Mideast/Japan soft.

text.p: Clean tanker chartering activity was thin on Friday and brokers said they thought a surplus of tonnage in some areas was depressing prices.

"With holidays throughout the world this week, mainstream activity has been much reduced, allowing traders to secure cheaper transportation on the regular routes," brokers Gibsons said in a weekly report.
Precious few fresh fixtures were seen although various routes were commanding smaller rates.
Mideast/Japan rates for 30,000 tonners were pegged slightly above W170 while Mideast/India routes for similarly sized vessels were worth around W200.
Cross-Med rates for 30,000 tonners were put at around W180 while slightly smaller cargoes to West Africa were worth W210.
Slow activity in the Caribbean was also pressuring prices for larger vessels, but rates for 30,000 tonners were holding firmer at around W265 for Caribs/USAC routes.
Inter/UKCont rates for 20,000 tonners were easier at around W230. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
